name: io.github.awpthorp/posterly
title: posterly
description: Validate, schedule, publish, and analyze social content across 18 platforms with posterly.

environmentVariables.name: POSTERLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: posterly API key. Optional for public signup tools; required for authenticated tools.

environmentVariables.name: POSTERLY_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Comma-separated tool sets to list: core, creative, inbox, google_business, admin, billing (signup tools are always listed). Default: every set. Every tool stays callable by name.
